# THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD: Brand System

> The canonical brand system for THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD: visual identity, voice and
> messaging, design tokens, approved assets, and a brand audit. Machine-readable copies of
> everything live under /ai/. Start there.

## Start here

- [AI manifest](https://brand.theword.world/ai/manifest.json): The doorway. Names every current resource, with versions and checksums.
- [Agent skill](https://brand.theword.world/ai/SKILL.md): The retrieval and audit workflow, in installable Agent Skills format.
- [Brand system](https://brand.theword.world/ai/brand-system.md): The complete standard as one Markdown document.
- [Design tokens](https://brand.theword.world/ai/tokens.json): Colors, typography, system tokens and states.
- [Brand audit](https://brand.theword.world/ai/audit.md): The rubric every piece of work is checked against.
- [Components](https://brand.theword.world/ai/components.json): Component specifications resolved against current tokens.
- [Assets](https://brand.theword.world/ai/assets.json): Every approved logo, photograph, and video, with usage rules.
- [Approved examples](https://brand.theword.world/ai/approved-examples.md): Worked output that passes the audit.
- [Anti-patterns](https://brand.theword.world/ai/anti-patterns.md): What not to do, including every DON'T and every banned word.

## Facts at a glance

Brand system version 5.8, messaging guide version 1.0, issued August 2026.
Palette: Midnight `#0B1A2D`, Word Blue `#023D6F`, Parchment `#F7F3EC`, Flame `#F85842`, Ember `#C13A24`, White `#FFFFFF`.
Typefaces: DM Serif Display, DM Serif Text, DM Sans.
Proportion: 60 / 30 / 10, Flame never above a tenth and never carrying text.
Standing law: text over video or photo footage uses a Midnight scrim with white type only, never Flame.
Documentary imagery only. Nothing stock, nothing staged, nothing generated.
Public mission line: Strengthening the local church to fulfill the Great Commission, until EVERY1 knows the name Jesus.

## Human-facing guides

- [Brand Guide](https://brand.theword.world/brand): Full visual identity. Logo usage, color, typography, layout, photography and video.
- [Messaging Guide](https://brand.theword.world/brand/messaging): Voice, tone, vocabulary, audiences, and proof policy.
- [Signatures](https://brand.theword.world/signatures): The signature masters that sign the record, and the law governing where each may be placed.

## The three initiatives

- [Sub-brands](https://brand.theword.world/brand#architecture): The three doors, told apart by ground, Flame ceiling, and register.
- [Letterhead](https://brand.theword.world/letterhead): The document template every record is set in.
- [Initiative messaging documents](https://brand.theword.world/documents): What each initiative is, in the words of the ministry.
- [EVERY1 Movement](https://brand.theword.world/brand/every1) · [messaging document](https://brand.theword.world/documents/every1)
- [Revival To My City](https://brand.theword.world/brand/revival-to-my-city) · [messaging document](https://brand.theword.world/documents/revival-to-my-city)
- [School of the Local Church](https://brand.theword.world/brand/school-of-the-local-church) · [messaging document](https://brand.theword.world/documents/school-of-the-local-church)
